Photograph of the white-border [[Shoo! Shoo! (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The complete photograph is available at the linked eBay image URL; the photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/t6YAAOSwUGxlxcxD/s-l1600.webp complete card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (205, 480)–(835, 1310) was extracted with the right and bottom coordinates exclusive. It was downsampled with Lanczos resampling to 350 × 461 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop, not a facsimile. The photograph or file acquisition date does not establish the card’s first publication date.
